name: Fusion Pricing Tables
author: Usman Ali Qureshi

sections.description:
Fusion Pricing Tables adds a flexible pricing table widget to Elementor. Create clean plan cards, compare monthly and yearly prices, highlight recommended offers, and style the result without writing code.

The free version includes 15 ready-made skins, repeatable plan content, feature lists, ribbons, billing toggles, and responsive controls. Fusion Pricing Tables Pro adds 35 more skins and deeper styling controls, for 50 skins in total.

Use it for SaaS pricing pages, service packages, agency retainers, membership tiers, hosting plans, product bundles, and any Elementor page that needs a clear pricing comparison.

Features

  • 15 included pricing table skins.
  • Monthly and yearly billing toggle.
  • Repeatable plans and feature lists.
  • Custom feature icons and disabled feature states.
  • Highlighted plan ribbons for recommended offers.
  • Responsive layout and alignment controls.
  • Typography, color, spacing, border, and background controls.
  • Configurable call-to-action buttons and links.
  • Frontend assets load only when the widget is used.

Pro Features

  • 35 additional skins, for 50 skins in total.
  • More advanced plan, header, price, and feature styling controls.
  • Extra hover effects and ribbon positioning controls.
  • Premium customer support.

External services

Fusion Pricing Tables uses the Freemius SDK for optional usage analytics, license management, Pro updates, account management, support contact forms, and checkout. Free users can skip the opt-in and continue using the plugin.

The plugin connects to Freemius only when an administrator opts in, activates a license, starts checkout, checks account details, submits a support contact form, or uses another Freemius powered account feature. The SDK may share the profile, website, product, plugin, theme, license, and diagnostic information described on its permission screen. Users can opt out of optional tracking from the Plugins screen or the Fusion Pricing Tables account screen.

Freemius provides its privacy policy and terms of service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fusion-pricing-tables folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit any page with Elementor and search for the ‘Pricing Plans’ widget.
  4. Drag and drop the widget onto your page and start customizing!
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Fusion Pricing Tables is an add-on for Elementor and requires the free version of Elementor to be installed and active.

Does the free version include usable designs?

Yes. The free version includes 15 pricing table skins and the main controls needed to build a complete pricing section.

Can I show monthly and yearly prices?

Yes. You can enable the billing toggle and enter separate monthly and yearly prices for each plan.

Can I use custom HTML in the feature lists?

Yes! You can use basic HTML tags like <strong>, <em>, or <a> safely within your feature text.

Does Fusion Pricing Tables load assets on every page?

No. Frontend styles and scripts are registered by the plugin and loaded only when the Pricing Plans widget is used.
